video.name: 4 Christian End Times Views Explained: Premillennial, Amillennial, Postmillennial
video.headline: Four Christian Views of the End Times, Side by Side
video.description: Christians agree Jesus is coming back but disagree about the thousand years of Revelation 20. This overview sets the four main evangelical views side by side: dispensational premillennialism, historic premillennialism, amillennialism and postmillennialism.
video.narrator: Narrated by Tom Daly, editor of Christian Curator
